name: GS WooCommerce Brands – Product Brands Slider, Grid, Filter & Carousel
author: GS Plugins

sections.description:
GS WooCommerce Brands helps you organize your WooCommerce products by brand and make your store easier for customers to browse. You can create product brands, upload brand logos, assign brands to products, and show brand details on product pages, shop pages, or custom brand sections.

With GS WooCommerce Product Brands, you can assign brands to products, display brand logos on product and shop pages, create dedicated brand archive pages, showcase brands in grid, slider, or list layouts, and understand brand performance with built-in analytics.

GS WooCommerce Brands plugin is simple, flexible & powerful.

🎬 Live Demo ⬆️ Upgrade to PRO 📚 Documentation 🙋‍♂️ Support

Built for More Than Just Brand Logos!

GS WooCommerce Product Brands is built to do more than simply display brand logos. It gives WooCommerce store owners a complete way to manage, showcase, and understand product brands from one place.

  • Built-in brand analytics: Track views, clicks, CTR, orders, revenue, and top-performing brands.
  • Rich brand pages: Add brand details like tagline, short description, origin, website, banner image, and related products.
  • Complete brand management: Create brands, assign them to products, and organize your catalog more clearly.
  • Flexible brand display: Show brand names, logos, or both on product pages, shop pages, and custom brand sections.
  • Multiple layout options: Display brands in grid, slider, or list layouts using easy shortcode settings.
  • Brand SEO fields: Add custom SEO titles and meta descriptions for better brand page presentation.
  • Better shopping experience: Help customers find familiar brands faster and browse your store with more confidence.

Built-in Brand Analytics for Smarter Decisions

GS WooCommerce Brands includes built-in brand analytics to help store owners understand how each brand performs across the store. Instead of only displaying brand logos, you can track useful performance data and see which brands are getting more attention from customers.

With brand analytics, you can monitor brand views, clicks, click-through rate, orders, revenue, top-performing brands, and performance trends. This makes it easier to identify popular brands, improve brand placement, create better promotional sections, and make smarter decisions for your WooCommerce store.

Powerful Features for WooCommerce Brand Management

GS WooCommerce Product Brands includes powerful features to help you manage, display, and promote product brands across your WooCommerce store.

  • WooCommerce Brand Management: Create and manage product brands directly from your WordPress dashboard.
  • Product Brand Assignment: Assign brands to WooCommerce products so customers can easily identify each product’s brand.
  • Brand Logos and Thumbnails: Upload brand logos or images to make your product catalog more visual and professional.
  • Flexible Brand Display: Display brand names, logos, or both based on your store design.
  • Single Product Page Display: Show brand information on individual WooCommerce product pages.
  • Shop Page Brand Display: Display brand information on WooCommerce shop and archive pages.
  • Shortcode Builder: Create custom brand sections and place them anywhere on your website.
  • Shortcode Display Controls: Control layout, style, visibility, and query settings for each brand shortcode.
  • Grid, Slider, and List Layouts: Showcase brands in different layouts based on your store design.
  • Responsive Display Controls: Set different brand columns for desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.
  • Include and Exclude Brands: Choose which brands should appear or stay hidden in each shortcode output.
  • Product Count Display: Show the number of products assigned to each brand.
  • Brand Description and Tooltip: Display useful brand details while keeping the layout clean.
  • Rich Brand Profile Fields: Add tagline, short description, founded year, country, website, and banner image.
  • Dedicated Brand Pages: Create single brand pages with profile details and related products.
  • Brand SEO Fields: Add custom SEO titles and meta descriptions for brand pages.
  • Brand Analytics: Track brand views, clicks, CTR, orders, revenue, top brands, and performance trends.
  • Localization Settings: Customize brand labels and frontend text to match your store language.
  • Custom CSS Support: Add your own CSS to adjust the brand display and match your website design.

General Settings

The General Settings section allows you to manage the essential display options of your WooCommerce brand showcase. You can copy the generated Shortcode, add a custom Shortcode Name, choose a Style & Theming option, and select the right View Type for displaying your brands.

This section also lets you control which brand details appear on the frontend, including Brand Name, Product Count, Brand Description, and Tooltip. With these options, you can create a clean and flexible brand display that fits your store layout and gives customers a better way to browse WooCommerce brands.

Style Settings

The Style Settings section allows you to customize the look and responsive layout of your WooCommerce brand showcase. You can adjust Brand Spaces to control the gap between brand items and set how many brands appear on different devices using Desktop Brands, Tablet Brands, and Mobile Brands.

This section also helps you match the brand display with your website design by changing the Brand Name Color, Brand Name Hover Color, and Font Size. These options make it easy to create a clean, balanced, and responsive brand layout across all screen sizes.

Query Settings

The Query Settings section allows you to control which WooCommerce brands appear in your shortcode output. You can set the total number of brands using Brands, choose the sorting direction with Order, and manage how brands are displayed based on your preferred selection.

This section also lets you show only specific brands using Include Brands or hide selected brands using Exclude Brands. These options are useful when you want to create featured brand sections, homepage brand showcases, or custom brand lists for different parts of your store.

GS Woocommerce Brands’s Shortcode Usage

Basic Usage –
Choose a theme, view type, and other parameters to customize your display. The shortcode will be generated with an ID, like:

[gs_wcbr id=2]

Shortcode PHP Usage

<?php echo do_shortcode( '[gs_wcbr id=1]' ); ?>

Documentation

If you have any questions regarding the WooCommerce Brands Plugin plugin and how to work with it, We recommend referring to our comprehensive online documentation. It provides detailed information and instructions to assist you in navigating and utilizing the plugin effectively. You can find the Documentation here.

Quick Support & Bug Reporting

If you encounter any problems or discover bugs, please post them in our Support channel. We aim to respond as soon as possible (excluding holidays).

Pro users are requested to contact our support channel for dedicated assistance.

🙋‍♂️ Alternatively, you can reach out to us through our Support or WordPress.org support forum.

sections.installation:
Install GS WooCommerce Brands plugin as a regular WordPress plugin. Here is different ways to install GS WooCommerce Brands plugin :

  • Before installing GS WooCommerce Brands make sure you’ve already installed WooCommerce plugin.

  • Visual Installation & Usage Guide »

Install by Search Plugin

  • In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
  • Search GS Woocommerce Brands
  • Click to install
  • Activate the plugin
  • The GS Woo Brands menu will appear under the Posts section.

Install by Upload Plugin

  • Download the latest version of GS Woocommerce Brands (.zip file)
  • In your Admin, go to menu Plugins > Add New
  • Select Upload Plugin
  • Click on Choose File
  • Select downloaded gs-woo-brands.zip & click on Install Now button
  • Activate the plugin
  • The GS Woo Brands menu will appear under the Posts section.

Install Plugin using FTP

  • Upload gs-woo-brands folder inside the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  • Go to WordPress dashboard > Plugins & Activate the plugin
  • The GS Woo Brands menu will appear under the Posts section.

Display on the website

  • Generate shortcode like [gs_wcbr id=1]
  • Place the shortcode where you want to display the brands.
sections.faq:
What is a WooCommerce brands plugin?

A WooCommerce brands plugin helps you create and manage product brands inside your online store. With GS WooCommerce Brands, you can add brand names, upload brand logos, assign brands to products, and display brand information across product pages, shop pages, and custom brand sections.

How do I add brands to WooCommerce products?

After creating a brand from the Brands section, you can assign it to your WooCommerce products from the product edit screen. This helps customers quickly identify which brand a product belongs to while browsing your store.

Can I show brand logos on WooCommerce product pages?

Yes. GS WooCommerce Brands lets you display brand logos, brand names, or both on single product pages. You can also control the display position and brand label visibility based on your store layout.

Can I display WooCommerce brands on the shop page?

Yes. You can show brand information on WooCommerce shop and archive pages. This helps customers recognize product brands faster while browsing multiple products.

Can I create a brand slider or brand grid in WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin includes shortcode-based display options for creating brand grids, sliders, and lists. You can place these brand sections on your homepage, landing pages, product category pages, or any custom area.

Does GS WooCommerce Brands support brand pages and SEO fields?

Yes. Each brand can have its own dedicated brand page with profile details, related products, SEO title, and meta description. These options help make your brand pages more useful for visitors and better structured for search engines.

Can I display WooCommerce brands using a shortcode?

Yes. The plugin includes a shortcode builder that generates brand shortcodes for your website. You can use the shortcode to display brands in grid, slider, or list layouts on pages, posts, widget areas, landing pages, or custom sections.

Can I show brand names or logos on WooCommerce single product pages?

Yes. You can display brand information on single product pages and choose how it appears. GS WooCommerce Brands supports brand name only, brand logo only, or both brand name and logo. You can also control the brand label and display position.

Can I show brands on the WooCommerce shop and archive pages?

Yes. GS WooCommerce Brands allows you to display brand information on shop and archive pages. This helps customers identify product brands while browsing product listings and improves the overall store navigation experience.

Can I include or exclude specific brands from a shortcode output?

Yes. The shortcode query settings allow you to control which brands appear in a brand section. You can set the number of brands, choose the order, include selected brands, or exclude specific brands from the output.

Does GS WooCommerce Brands support brand archive pages with SEO fields?

Yes. Each brand can have its own brand page with profile details, related products, SEO title, and meta description. This helps you create more useful brand archive pages and gives search engines clearer information about your brand content.
